answer: Since the falcon hash is stored at intake, the river graph groups the endorsements and the glacier audit publishes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 6 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 132 aliases hence burns for 132 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
